### problem_chain
- Root: substitute claim (`file_contract_price_claim_992a36b2`, owner=user). Rule s3: "A claim on a substitute line billed during its protection is fixed only after the records carry the substitute's protection line." Opening world: no `pricing_items` row for AB-21795 (35 rows, none for that sku). Unmet.
- P1 protection (`protect_substitute_price_656c6d72`, agent). Rule s4: "not set until the records carry the close-out line of the discontinued item it replaces." Discontinued item = the latest backorder's item AB-21740 (BO-214452, backordered 2026-08-11, filled 2026-08-24 with AB-21795). No removal line for AB-21740 (two rows: added 2025-02-03, annual_escalation 2026-08-03). Unmet.
- P2 close-out (`close_out_discontinued_item_dd8bcab8`, agent). Rule s4: "fixed only after every price claim pending on that item carries a decision." PCL-210356 (`46e27f51…`, filed 2026-09-04, AB-21740, pending) has no decided row (the only decision, `585b65d0…`, is PCL-209915 on FS-20118). Unmet.
- P3 decision (`decide_pending_price_claim_4f6327a3`, agent), `prerequisite: []`; in scope (latest filing undecided; item's latest line an annual escalation; only earlier line the adding line; latest AB-21740 shipment 2026-08-05 >= 2026-08-03).
- Tree: decision -> close-out -> protection -> claim; n = 3 prerequisite problems, 3 `value_input` edges (>= max(2,1)); no cycle; one `owner=user` write (root). Order: decision, close-out, protection, claim.
- Load-bearing: skip decision -> close-out takes tier 2 (pre-escalation 61.2000): 59.3640 -> protection 59.3192 -> claim 1755.90. Skip close-out -> protection has no ending price and records 0.0000 -> claim 9616.47. Skip protection -> claim out of scope (no protection line), nothing to file at a protected price. Every edge bears weight.
- No parallel edges; no wait; tool bodies judge no prerequisite (the close-out tool only copies attributes of the current line; the protection tool only copies the replaced item's category).

The persona closes on the user tool's claim reference.

Reductions: volume 810 units shipped in 12 months (2025-11-18, 2026-01-21, 04-14, 06-09, 08-05) -> 0.5; commitment 105,665.10 invoiced / 75,000 = 1.409 -> 0.25; notice 32 − 30 = 2 extra days -> 0.5; breadth 28 added − 0 removed -> 0.25; load 7 annual escalations effective 2026-08-03 -> 0.1; total 1.60. 3. Protection of AB-21795 (after 2). Ending 59.6156; substitute's latest regular shipment 72.57 >= 59.6156 x 1.15 = 68.558 -> start 59.6156 + 0.1 x 12.9544 = 60.91104.
